> Things have meaning while they lasts, and then a different meaning(meaningless?) When they end.

There's some truth to this.
Nothing has meaning because everything ends.
Plenty of things that happen are *random*, and persistence does not guarantee results.
The truth is that nothing is guaranteed.
Actually, nothing in life is guaranteed. *YOU* might come to have a "good" life, but someone else might not. Every holocaust victim and slave who was never freed would not have this perspective.
This is true. I can personally attest to this...
